name: Dr. Nadeem ul Haque
detail: Former Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission of Pakistan; co-authored 'Wealth tax is a bad idea' (The News, July 2025) arguing wealth taxes distort capital formation and destroy wealth.

name: Shahid Kardar
detail: Former Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan; co-authored 'Wealth tax is a bad idea' (The News, July 2025) arguing against wealth taxation.

name: International Monetary Fund
detail: In 2024-2025 budget negotiations, the IMF rejected Pakistan FBR proposals to introduce a wealth tax or capital value tax on movable assets and gold, directing Pakistan to focus exclusively on income tax.

name: Dr. Hafiz A. Pasha
detail: Prominent economist and former Finance Minister. In 'Growth and Inequality in Pakistan' (2018) and related analyses, recommends Capital Value Tax (CVT) on urban real estate, inheritance tax, and capital gains tax reforms rather than a comprehensive net wealth tax.

name: Dr. Atif Mian
detail: Professor of Economics at Princeton. Proposes aggressive urban land taxation (land value taxation) and real estate property tax reform to unlock speculative capital, which is excluded under Section 2 of the methodology as land/property taxation.

name: Awami Workers Party
detail: Left-wing political party. 2024 election manifesto emphasizes progressive income taxation on all sectors, including agricultural income and commercial property, but does not specify a net wealth tax.

name: Karamat Ali
detail: Veteran labour leader and founding director of the Pakistan Institute of Labour Education and Research (PILER); supported progressive wealth taxation but passed away in June 2024.

name: Prof. Khurshid Ahmad
detail: Former Senator and Jamaat-e-Islami economist who advocated wealth taxation in Islamic economic frameworks; passed away in April 2025.

name: Mushahid Ullah Khan
detail: PML-N Senator and Parliamentary Leader in Senate who demanded wealth tax on billionaires during budget debates; passed away in February 2021.

name: Dr. Akmal Hussain
detail: Prominent political economist; proposes progressive property taxes on multiple residences, agricultural income tax, and removal of elite concessions rather than a net wealth tax.

name: Raza Rabbani
detail: Former Chairman of the Senate and senior PPP leader; champions provincial fiscal autonomy, NFC awards, and corporate super tax cases, but does not propose a net wealth tax.

name: Amanullah Turk
detail: Wrote a letter to the editor in Dawn ('A plea: wealth tax instead of RGST', November 2010) calling for wealth tax revival; excluded as a private citizen.

name: Miftah Ismail
detail: Introduced Section 7E deemed income tax on immovable property and corporate super taxes under Finance Act 2022, not a general net wealth tax.

name: Muhammad Aurangzeb
detail: Focuses on broadening income tax net, provincial agricultural income tax harmonization, and Section 116 wealth statement reconciliation; has not endorsed a net wealth tax.

name: Shaukat Aziz
detail: Held the Wealth Tax Act 1963 in abeyance in the 2000 budget and formally repealed it via Finance Act 2003.

name: Dr. Ishrat Husain
detail: Advocates urban immovable property tax, cadastral GIS mapping, and personal income tax base broadening, not a net wealth tax.

name: Rana Junaid Zahid
detail: Authored analytical article 'A case for reintroducing wealth tax' evaluating pros, cons, and capital flight risks without an unequivocal activist policy endorsement.
